title: DSG PLayIT v2.1.8
changelog:
- Fixed Touch & Hold for 2X speed gesture recognition and event consumption conflict
- Unified gesture engine orchestrating hold-to-speed, swipe drag, and single/double-tap detection
- Smooth 2X Speed HUD badge indicator with haptic feedback on hold activation
- Accurate playback speed and play/pause state restoration upon releasing hold
- Improved gesture touch isolation preventing unintended control toggles and accidental skips
